subject: Time distribution survey reply from GP
body: GP estimates for pitch deck 'Where My Time Goes' slide. Totals 100. org_infrastructure: 55 (repo setup, pre-commit hooks, publish pipeline, CI/CD, polyfill.io removal). agent_management: 35 (status board, 1:1s, inbox triage, protocol maintenance). product_strategy: 5 (flag scope decisions; Marcus decides). research_evals: 5 (audit runs, cross-exam verify, schema checks). Suggested new category: agent_coordination -- covers dispatching sprints and cross-agent comms distinct from agent_management proper.
